message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data only from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check for any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels from text files and uses them directly without any comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected set, or noise-detection tooling like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to training samples during data preparation; images are loaded and transformed without any integrity or distribution checks.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via flags like `args.pretrained` passed to model constructors (e.g., Resnet, VGG, Mobilenet_v3) with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the snippet.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses Counter from collections and logs dataset statistics, but there is no explicit check validating label distribution, class balance thresholds, or expected label sets before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern anomaly analysis, or gradient-based backdoor defense anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: There is no import or usage of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate dataloader_test/dataloader_train/dataloader_val objects are passed, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no enforcement that the test set is isolated from training data, and only a single evaluation path is used without independent metric cross-checks.

No detected input sanitization: The inference/test path loads data through dataloaders and checks only for file existence; there are no shape/range validation checks or schema enforcement on incoming inputs before they reach the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on model outputs are visible in the test function or surrounding inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline is a vision/metric-learning system (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
